label: Oil Production
change: Hydrocarbons Minister Paula Henao and PDVSA's Jovanny Martínez told a Houston investor showcase on Aug 19 that national output stands at ~1.25M bpd, with a long-term recovery target of 3M bpd; the January regulatory reform (implementing rules issued July) expands private participation across the full value chain, with bp, ADNOC-backed XRG and UCC cited as Loran gas-field partners; Chevron's Q2 2026 earnings call separately reported ~280K bpd gross from PDVSA joint ventures (up ~15% over 6 months), with CFO Eimear Bonner citing room to raise Venezuelan volumes up to 50% by end-2028
source: World Oil / Bloomberg / EIA / Chevron / PDVSA (Aug 19, 2026)

label: Annual Inflation
change: Monthly inflation more than doubled in June — third-highest reading of 2026 after Jan (32.6%) and Feb (14.6%) — as the bolívar slid from ~620 to ~720/USD within weeks; economists attribute the spike mainly to currency devaluation, not the June 24 earthquakes; IMF April 2026 WEO projected 218–387% full-year 2026 average
source: BCV / Trading Economics / IMF April 2026 WEO

label: GDP (USD)
change: IMF April 2026 WEO projects +4.0% real GDP growth for 2026; oil sector recovery and post-Maduro international re-engagement driving rebound; IMF and World Bank resumed formal engagement post-transition

label: PDVSA Oil Revenue
change: −85% from ~$80B peak; oil investment +55% to $1.4B in 2026

label: Potential Banking Liquidity Injection
change: OFAC General Licenses expanded under political transition

label: Earthquake Damage & Reconstruction Cost
change: World Bank's August 2026 assessment placed physical damage at ~$19.6–20B, versus the UN's earlier $37B estimate including reconstruction; World Bank warned 'build back better' costs could reach $50B and GDP may stay below pre-earthquake levels until 2036 without sufficient investment; Rodríguez government secured $346M in emergency IMF financing plus $300M pledged by the US and $36.5M from the European Commission, but the UN's $931M 2026 humanitarian appeal remained only 39% funded as of early August
